```css
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
    padding: 0;
}

.app-title-home svg {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    display: block;
}

.app-title-home:hover,
.app-title-home:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

/* Undo/redo buttons carry the `disabled` attribute while their history stack
   is empty (see updateUndoRedoButtons in create-lesson.js). Without this rule
   the attribute blocked clicks but the buttons still LOOKED live — the exact
   rule create-quiz.css already ships, so both editors dim identically. */
.app-title-home:disabled {
    opacity: 0.35;
    cursor: default;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.app-title-text {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    max-width: 260px;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
    line-height: 1.4;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.app-title-text:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-border);
    background: var(--color-background);
}

.app-title-text.editing {
    cursor: text;
    overflow: visible;
    white-space: nowrap;
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-light);
    background: var(--color-surface);
    outline: none;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .app-title-bar {
        right: 0;
    }

    .app-title-bar,
    .global-md-bar,
    .menu-bar {
        right: 0;
        padding-left: 16px;
        padding-right: 16px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .app-title-bar {
        padding-left: 8px;
        padding-right: 8px;
        /* The whole bar scrolls horizontally on phones — same behavior as
       #globalMdBar — instead of trapping the menu inside its own
       vertically-scrolled dropdown. */
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: hidden;
        scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .app-title-bar::-webkit-scrollbar {
        display: none;
    }

    .app-title-start {
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .app-title-text {
        max-width: 120px;
    }

    .app-bar-menu {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .menu-bar-inner {
        /* No longer scrolls internally — the parent .app-title-bar scrolls. */
        overflow: visible;
    }
}

/* ============================================================================
   BUTTONS
   ============================================================================ */

.btn {
    padding: 12px 24px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, background 0.2s;
    font-family: inherit;
    white-space: nowrap;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
}

.btn svg {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.btn:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
}

.btn:disabled {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: none;
}

.btn-primary {
    background: var(--gradient-accent);
    color: white;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.btn-secondary {
    background: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
}

.btn-secondary:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.btn-sm {
    padding: 7px 14px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    border-radius: 7px;
}

.btn-sm:hover {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: none;
}

/* Small icon-only utility buttons used throughout the section/block cards
   (move up/down, delete). */
.lesson-icon-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    padding: 0;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}

.lesson-icon-btn svg {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
}

.lesson-icon-btn:hover,
.lesson-icon-btn:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-background);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    outline: none;
}

.lesson-icon-btn:disabled {
    opacity: 0.35;
    cursor: default;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.lesson-icon-btn-danger:hover,
.lesson-icon-btn-danger:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-error-light);
    color: var(--color-error);
}

/* ============================================================================
   CARDS & FORM ELEMENTS
   ============================================================================ */

.card {
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    background: var(--color-surface);
    transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.card:hover {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.card h2 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin: 0 0 14px 0;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
}

.card h2 svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    color: var(--color-primary);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.form-group {
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.form-group:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

.form-group label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.form-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 14px;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .form-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

.form-input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 9px 14px;
    border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--color-background);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}

textarea.form-input {
    resize: vertical;
    min-height: 60px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.form-input:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-light);
}

select.form-input {
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* ============================================================================
   ENTRY SCREEN — conceptually mirrors create-quiz.css's .entry-* shapes,
   authored fresh here per the plan (own file, not an import).
   ============================================================================ */

.entry-screen {
    padding: 8px 0 0 0;
}

.entry-sections {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.entry-section {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.entry-section:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

.entry-screen-heading {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    margin: 0 0 14px 0;
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}

.entry-items-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr));
    gap: 20px;
}

.entry-item-wrap {
    position: relative;
}

.entry-item,
.entry-item-new {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    width: 100%;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 0;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
    text-align: right;
}

.entry-item-thumb {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

.entry-item-thumb svg {
    width: 30%;
    height: 30%;
}

.entry-item-thumb-new {
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    border-style: dashed;
    border-width: 2px;
}

.entry-item:hover .entry-item-thumb,
.entry-item:focus-visible .entry-item-thumb,
.entry-item-new:hover .entry-item-thumb,
.entry-item-new:focus-visible .entry-item-thumb {
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.entry-item:focus-visible .entry-item-thumb,
.entry-item-new:focus-visible .entry-item-thumb {
    outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
    outline-offset: 2px;
}

.entry-item-title {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.entry-item-new .entry-item-title {
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.entry-item-meta {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
}

.entry-item-more-wrap {
    position: absolute;
    top: 8px;
    right: 8px;
}

.entry-item-more-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}

.entry-item-more-btn svg {
    width: 15px;
    height: 15px;
}

.entry-item-more-btn:hover,
.entry-item-more-btn:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-background);
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

.entry-item-menu {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 4px);
    right: 0;
    min-width: 150px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    padding: 6px;
    z-index: 40;
}

.entry-item-menu.open {
    display: block;
}

.entry-item-menu-option {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    text-align: right;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.entry-item-menu-option svg {
    width: 15px;
    height: 15px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.entry-item-menu-option:hover,
.entry-item-menu-option:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-background);
}

.entry-item-menu-option-danger {
    color: var(--color-error);
}

.entry-item-menu-option-danger svg {
    color: var(--color-error);
}

.entry-item-menu-option-danger:hover,
.entry-item-menu-option-danger:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-error-light);
}

/* Skeleton loader */
.entry-skeleton-heading {
    width: 140px;
    height: 14px;
    margin: 0 0 14px 0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--color-border);
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.entry-skeleton-tile {
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--color-border);
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.entry-skeleton-heading::after,
.entry-skeleton-tile::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 60%, transparent), transparent);
    animation: skeletonShimmer 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes skeletonShimmer {
    0% {
        transform: translateX(100%);
    }

    100% {
        transform: translateX(-100%);
    }
}

.entry-not-admin-message {
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    padding: 24px;
    text-align: center;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .entry-items-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px, 1fr));
        gap: 14px;
    }
}

/* ============================================================================
   LESSON EDITOR SHELL
   ============================================================================ */

.lesson-creator {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
}

/* ============================================================================
   SECTION LIST
   ============================================================================ */

.lesson-sections-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.lesson-sections-header h2 {
    margin: 0;
}

.sections-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 16px;
}

.lesson-section-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--color-background);
    padding: 14px;
    scroll-margin-top: 60px;
}

.lesson-section-card-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.lesson-section-title-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 200px;
}

.lesson-section-index {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.lesson-section-title-input {
    flex: 1;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.lesson-section-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.lesson-section-hidden-toggle {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    white-space: nowrap;
    padding: 0 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.lesson-section-hidden-toggle input {
    cursor: pointer;
}

.lesson-blocks-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.lesson-add-block-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
}

/* ============================================================================
   BLOCK CARDS (per-type editors)
   ============================================================================ */

.lesson-block-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    padding: 12px;
}

.lesson-block-card-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.lesson-block-type-label {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.lesson-block-card-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
}

/* ── Markdown block write/preview toggle ─────────────────────────────────── */

.lesson-md-editor {
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.lesson-md-tabs {
    display: flex;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    background: var(--color-background);
}

.lesson-md-tab {
    padding: 7px 16px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    margin-bottom: -1px;
    transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.lesson-md-tab.active {
    color: var(--color-primary);
    border-bottom-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.lesson-md-textarea {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 120px;
    padding: 12px;
    border: none;
    background: var(--color-background);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font-family: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    resize: vertical;
}

.lesson-md-textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
}

.lesson-md-preview {
    padding: 12px;
    min-height: 60px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
}

/* ── Media block ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.lesson-media-editor {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
}

.lesson-media-dropzone {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 20px;
    border: 2px dashed var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--color-background);
    text-align: center;
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.lesson-media-dropzone.is-dragover {
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.lesson-media-dropzone p {
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.lesson-media-file-input {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.lesson-media-preview img.lesson-media-preview-img {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 240px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: block;
}

.lesson-media-preview video.lesson-media-preview-video {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 240px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: block;
}

.lesson-media-preview audio {
    width: 100%;
}

.lesson-media-uploading {
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}

/* ── Quiz-reference block ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.lesson-quizref-results {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-top: 6px;
    max-height: 200px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.lesson-quizref-result {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    text-align: right;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.lesson-quizref-result:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.lesson-quizref-result-count {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.lesson-quizref-no-results {
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    padding: 6px 2px;
}

.lesson-quizref-selected {
    margin-top: 10px;
}

.lesson-quizref-chip {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary-dark);
}

.lesson-quizref-chip-title {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.lesson-quizref-chip-count {
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.lesson-quizref-empty,
.lesson-quizref-unresolved {
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}


.lesson-lessonref-chip {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.lesson-lessonref-chip-main {
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.lesson-lessonref-chip-title {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.lesson-lessonref-chip-status {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.lesson-lessonref-chip-actions {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.lesson-lessonref-chip-btn {
    min-height: 36px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.lesson-lessonref-chip-btn:hover,
.lesson-lessonref-chip-btn:focus-visible {
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
    outline: none;
}

.lesson-lessonref-chip-btn.is-danger:hover,
.lesson-lessonref-chip-btn.is-danger:focus-visible {
    border-color: var(--color-error);
    color: var(--color-error);
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .lesson-lessonref-chip {
        align-items: stretch;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .lesson-lessonref-chip-actions {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .lesson-lessonref-chip-btn {
        flex: 1 1 0;
    }
}

/* ── Embedded question block ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.lesson-question-prompt {
    resize: vertical;
}

.lesson-question-options {
    margin: 12px 0;
}

.lesson-question-options>label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.lesson-question-option-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.lesson-question-option-row input[type="radio"] {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    accent-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.lesson-question-option-row .form-input {
    flex: 1;
}

.lesson-adaptive-rule {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    padding-top: 10px;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--color-border);
}

.lesson-adaptive-rule label {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

/* ============================================================================
   CREATE-PAGE SECTION NAVIGATOR (sidebar widget)
   Same visual language as create-quiz.css's .create-question-navigator*,
   authored fresh here since create-lesson.html doesn't load create-quiz.css.
   ============================================================================ */

.create-question-navigator {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin-top: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    overflow: hidden;
    direction: rtl;
}

.create-question-navigator-toggle {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 42px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 11px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.84rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.create-question-navigator-toggle:hover,
.create-question-navigator-toggle:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-background);
    outline: none;
}

.create-question-navigator.is-open .create-question-navigator-toggle {
    border-end-start-radius: 0;
    border-end-end-radius: 0;
}

.create-question-navigator-toggle>svg:first-child {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.create-question-navigator-count {
    min-width: 22px;
    padding: 1px 6px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    text-align: center;
}

.create-question-navigator-chevron {
    width: 15px;
    height: 15px;
    margin-right: auto;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

.create-question-navigator:not(.is-open) .create-question-navigator-chevron {
    transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.create-question-navigator-panel {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 6px;
    max-height: min(38vh, 330px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 8px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}

.create-question-navigator-panel:empty {
    display: none;
}

.create-question-navigator-panel[hidden] {
    display: none;
}

.create-question-nav-item {
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: var(--color-background-secondary);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.create-question-nav-item:hover {
    transform: scale(1.04);
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.create-question-nav-item.incomplete {
    border-color: var(--color-warning);
    color: var(--color-warning);
}

body:not(.lesson-form-active) .create-question-navigator {
    display: none;
}

/* ============================================================================
   PREVIEW-ONLY HELPERS (used by previewLesson()'s new-tab document)
   ============================================================================ */

.lesson-preview-quizref {
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary-dark);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    margin: 12px 0;
}

.lesson-preview-question ol {
    padding-inline-start: 20px;
    margin-top: 8px;
}

.lesson-preview-question li.is-correct {
    color: var(--color-success);
    font-weight: 700;
}

/* ============================================================================
   GLOBAL MARKDOWN + LATEX TOOLBAR (#globalMdBar) + WRITE/PREVIEW FIELDS
   ============================================================================
   Ported verbatim from create-quiz.css (same #globalMdBar markup, same
   .md-source/.wp-field write/preview editor shape) so this page gets the
   exact same authoring toolbar/undo history as create-quiz — see
   create-lesson.js's setupGlobalMdBar()/applyGlobalMdAction() port and
   equipMarkdownFields()'s use of mdEditorHtml() for the write/preview
   fields these rules style. A couple of selectors here reference classes
   quiz-only (.option-md-wrap, .preview-question) that never appear on
   this page — harmless dead weight kept so this block stays a literal
   copy rather than a hand-trimmed one that can drift out of sync.
   ============================================================================ */

.undo-redo-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.global-md-bar {
    position: fixed;
    top: 44px;
    left: 0;
    right: var(--sidebar-collapsed-width);
    height: 40px;
    z-index: 49;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 0 12px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    transition: right 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* When background animations are enabled, --color-surface becomes
   semi-transparent (see themes.css) so the animated shader shows through
   panels/cards — appropriate for large surfaces, but this toolbar's text
   (.gmd-btn-latex in particular) was contrast-checked against an OPAQUE
   surface color; layering it over a moving, unpredictable background
   could silently drop it below AA depending on what's rendered behind it
   at any given moment. backdrop-filter's blur keeps the same "shows
   through" feel without ever letting the raw background color show
   through at full strength under the text itself. */
html[data-animations="enabled"] .global-md-bar {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
}

/* Same reasoning as .global-md-bar above, but for the dropdown POPOVERS
   themselves (.gmd-dropdown-menu, .menu-dropdown incl. its submenu
   variant) — these render position:fixed, detached from the toolbar/menu
   bar's own DOM box, so they don't inherit that bar's blur just because
   the bar has one. Each is its own semi-transparent --color-surface panel
   in Lightfall mode and needs the same treatment, or .gmd-btn-latex's
   label (and every .menu-option label) is only contrast-safe against an
   opaque surface that Lightfall mode never actually gives it. */
html[data-animations="enabled"] .gmd-dropdown-menu,
html[data-animations="enabled"] .menu-dropdown {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
}

.global-md-bar::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

body.sidebar-expanded .global-md-bar {
    right: var(--sidebar-expanded-width);
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .global-md-bar {
        right: 0;
    }
}

.gmd-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.gmd-separator {
    width: 1px;
    height: 20px;
    background: var(--color-border);
    margin: 0 6px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.gmd-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    min-width: 30px;
    height: 28px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.gmd-btn:hover,
.gmd-btn:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    outline: none;
}

.gmd-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.93);
}

/* LaTeX buttons — real icons (see .gmd-icon-math below for the
   superscript/subscript/fraction/inline-math glyphs, which render their
   mathematical notation as SVG <text> rather than plain button text: this
   keeps their exact visual shape — "x" raised/lowered relative to a small
   exponent, a fraction bar between two glyphs — independent of the
   surrounding page's font/line-height, which plain text content inside a
   26px button could not guarantee). Slightly different accent color than
   the plain-markdown .gmd-btn group so the two toolbar sections stay
   visually distinguishable at a glance. */
.gmd-btn-latex {
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.gmd-btn-latex:hover,
.gmd-btn-latex:focus-visible {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 12%, transparent);
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

/* The four math buttons whose icon is built from SVG <text> (sup/sub/frac/
   inline-math) rather than <path> strokes — text needs fill, not stroke.
   The page is dir="rtl" (Arabic UI), and SVG <text> inherits CSS
   `direction`; with no explicit text-anchor, RTL direction reverses the
   glyph's flow from its x coordinate, pushing it off the left edge of the
   viewBox entirely (this is what made #gmdSup / #gmdSub render as empty
   buttons). Forcing ltr here keeps every math glyph anchored the way its
   x/y coordinates were authored, independent of page direction. */
.gmd-icon-math text {
    fill: currentColor;
    direction: ltr;
    unicode-bidi: bidi-override;
}

/* Tooltip for "no field focused" state — shown via JS as a brief flash */
.gmd-no-field-tip {
    position: fixed;
    top: calc(44px + 40px + 6px);
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--color-text-primary);
    color: var(--color-surface);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    padding: 5px 14px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    z-index: 200;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.18s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.gmd-no-field-tip.visible {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* ── Dropdown toggles (heading levels, "more" LaTeX symbols) ────────────── */
/* .gmd-dropdown-menu uses position:fixed (set via inline top/left in JS,
   anchored to its toggle button) rather than position:absolute. The
   toolbar itself scrolls horizontally (overflow-x: auto) and clips
   vertical overflow (overflow-y: hidden) so its buttons don't visually
   spill past the fixed bar's height — an absolutely-positioned dropdown
   anchored inside it would be clipped by that same overflow:hidden and
   never actually appear. Fixed positioning escapes the clipping ancestor
   entirely. */
.gmd-dropdown {
    position: relative;
}

.gmd-dropdown-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
}

.gmd-dropdown-toggle .gmd-caret {
    width: 9px;
    height: 9px;
    opacity: 0.7;
}

/* Icon glyphs inside .gmd-btn (bold/italic/heading/etc.) — sized to sit
   comfortably inside the 26px-tall button without the button growing. */
.gmd-icon {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.gmd-dropdown-menu {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 200;
    display: none;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    padding: 4px;
}

.gmd-dropdown-menu.open {
    display: flex;
}

/* Heading menu: single column list, one level per row */
.gmd-dropdown-menu--headings {
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 130px;
}

.gmd-dropdown-menu--headings .gmd-btn {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    height: auto;
}

/* LaTeX "more" menu: one symbol per row, label next to it, so each command
   is identifiable without hovering for the tooltip. */
.gmd-dropdown-menu--latex {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    min-width: 210px;
    max-width: 260px;
    max-height: 60vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.gmd-dropdown-menu--latex .gmd-btn-latex {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    height: auto;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;
}

.gmd-dropdown-menu--latex .gmd-btn-latex-symbol {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 24px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.gmd-dropdown-menu--latex .gmd-btn-latex-symbol .gmd-icon {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
}

/* Mathematical notation (Σ, ∫, π, ±, ≤, ≥, ≠, ∞) has no meaningful icon
   beyond the symbol itself, so these render as styled glyphs rather than
   plain inline text — sized and weighted to match the SVG icons next to
   them in the same menu. */
.gmd-dropdown-menu--latex .gmd-btn-latex-symbol--char {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
}

.app-bar-menu {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .app-bar-menu {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
    }
}

.menu-bar-item {
    position: relative;
}

.menu-trigger {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 5px;
    padding: 5px 9px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: .82rem;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.menu-trigger:hover,
.menu-trigger:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    outline: none;
}

.menu-dropdown {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 5px);
    right: 0;
    z-index: 80;
    display: none;
    min-width: 170px;
    padding: 5px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.menu-dropdown.open {
    display: grid;
    gap: 2px;
}

.menu-option {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 5px;
    padding: 7px 9px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    text-align: right;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: .82rem;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.menu-option:hover:not(:disabled),
.menu-option:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    outline: none;
}

.menu-option:disabled {
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: .5;
}

.gmd-dropdown-menu--latex .gmd-btn-latex-label {
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.wp-field {
    width: 100%;
    border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--color-background);
    transition:
        border-color 0.18s,
        box-shadow 0.18s;
}

.wp-field:focus-within {
    border-color: var(--color-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-light);
}

.wp-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 0 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    background: var(--color-surface);
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.wp-tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
}

.wp-tab {
    padding: 9px 14px;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
        color 0.15s,
        border-color 0.15s;
    margin-bottom: -1px;
}

.wp-tab:hover {
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.wp-tab.active {
    color: var(--color-primary);
    border-bottom-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.wp-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 4px 0;
}

.wp-tool-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    padding: 0;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: none;
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
        background 0.15s,
        color 0.15s;
}

.wp-tool-btn svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
}

.wp-tool-btn:hover {
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

.wp-tool-dropdown {
    position: relative;
}

.wp-heading-menu {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 4px);
    right: 0;
    z-index: 20;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 110px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    padding: 4px;
    gap: 1px;
}

.wp-heading-option {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: right;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    border: none;
    background: none;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s;
}

.wp-heading-option:hover {
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

.wp-pane-wrap {
    position: relative;
}

/* Selectors are doubled up (`.form-group textarea.wp-textarea` as well as
   plain `.wp-textarea`) so this wins in the cascade over the generic
   `.form-group textarea` / `.form-group textarea:focus` rules above.
   Question-text and explanation fields render `.wp-textarea` *inside* a
   `.form-group` (see renderQuestion()), so without this the more-specific
   `.form-group textarea` rule was winning instead — giving the field its
   own 2px border, its own `resize: vertical`, and on focus its own
   border-color + box-shadow ring stacked directly on top of .wp-field's
   ring below. That combination was both the visible "double border" and
   the manual resize handle the field wasn't supposed to have. */
.form-group textarea.wp-textarea,
.wp-textarea {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border: none;
    background: var(--color-background);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    resize: none;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: block;
    overflow: hidden;
    direction: rtl;
}

/* The focus ring lives on the outer .wp-field wrapper (border-color +
   box-shadow above). Without this, the textarea's own default browser
   focus outline — and, inside a .form-group, the generic
   `.form-group textarea:focus` border/box-shadow — drew on top of that
   ring at the same time, making an active field look like it had two
   borders stacked on each other. */
.form-group textarea.wp-textarea:focus,
.wp-textarea:focus,
.wp-textarea:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    border: none;
    box-shadow: none;
    transform: none;
}

.wp-textarea:placeholder-shown {
    text-align: right;
}

/* GitHub-style drag-and-drop media embedding: visual feedback while a file
   is dragged over a markdown field (question text, options, explanation,
   essay/formal answer — every .md-source textarea gets this via
   setupMarkdownMediaDropzone). Applied to the textarea's wrapper so the
   whole field visibly lights up as a drop target. */
.wp-field:has(.md-source--drag-active) {
    border-color: var(--gradient-start, #6366f1);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--gradient-start, #6366f1) 25%, transparent);
}

.md-source--drag-active {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gradient-start, #6366f1) 6%, var(--color-background));
}

.wp-preview-pane {
    min-height: 60px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    word-break: break-word;
}

.wp-footer {
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    background: var(--color-surface);
}

.wp-hint {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
}

.md-placeholder {
    color: var(--color-text-tertiary);
    font-style: italic;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.wp-preview-pane .inline-code,
.preview-question .inline-code,
.option-md-wrap .inline-code {
    background: var(--color-primary-light);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 1px 6px;
    font-family: "Fira Code", "Courier New", monospace;
    font-size: 0.88em;
    font-style: normal;
}

.gmd-select {
    height: 28px;
    max-width: 125px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.lesson-preview-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 300;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    padding: 20px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .48);
}

.lesson-preview-panel {
    width: min(920px, 100%);
    max-height: calc(100vh - 40px);
    overflow: auto;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.lesson-preview-topbar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}

.lesson-preview-badge {
    color: var(--color-success);
    font-size: .82rem;
    font-weight: 700;
}

body.lesson-preview-open {
    overflow: hidden;
}

.lesson-question-type-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
}

/* ============================================================================
   HIGHLIGHT COLOR PICKER  (Google-Docs-style; markup from
   src/shared/color-picker.js). Kept identical in create-quiz.css and
   create-lesson.css — see the note at the top of each about intentionally
   duplicated toolbar styles.

   ROOT-CAUSE NOTE — why the old menu "stayed open forever": the previous
   rule `.gmd-dropdown-menu--highlight { display: grid }` had the same
   specificity as the base `.gmd-dropdown-menu { display: none }` and came
   LATER in the file, so it always won and the menu was permanently visible
   regardless of the `.open` class. Layout below is therefore applied ONLY
   under `.open`; the closed state falls through to the base `display: none`.
   ============================================================================ */

.gmd-dropdown-menu--highlight {
    /* No `display` here on purpose — see the note above. */
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    min-width: 0;
    width: max-content;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 16px);
    padding: 10px;
    max-height: min(80vh, 460px);
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.gmd-dropdown-menu--highlight.open {
    display: flex;
}

.cp-reset {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 5px 6px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    text-align: right;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.cp-reset svg {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.cp-reset:hover,
.cp-reset:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-surface-hover, rgba(127, 127, 127, 0.12));
    outline: none;
}

.cp-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.cp-row,
.cp-recent {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
}

.cp-recent {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cp-swatch {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    padding: 0;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    background: var(--cp-color);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.1s ease, box-shadow 0.1s ease;
}

.cp-swatch:hover,
.cp-swatch:focus-visible {
    transform: scale(1.18);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-surface), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-primary);
    outline: none;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.cp-section-title {
    margin-top: 4px;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.cp-custom {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
}

.cp-tool {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    padding: 0;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.cp-tool svg {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
}

.cp-tool:hover,
.cp-tool:focus-visible,
.cp-tool:focus-within {
    background: var(--color-surface-hover, rgba(127, 127, 127, 0.12));
    color: var(--color-primary);
    outline: none;
}

/* The native color input is visually hidden but still the real control the
   surrounding <label> activates — kept in the layout box (not display:none)
   so the OS picker anchors next to the "+" button. */
.cp-native {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    opacity: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
}

.cp-hex {
    width: 84px;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 28px;
    padding: 0 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--color-background);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    text-align: left;
}

.cp-hex:focus {
    outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
    outline-offset: 0;
}

.cp-hex.is-invalid {
    border-color: var(--color-error);
    outline-color: var(--color-error);
}

.cp-apply {
    height: 28px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--color-primary);
    color: #fff;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.cp-apply:hover,
.cp-apply:focus-visible {
    background: var(--color-primary-hover, var(--color-primary));
    outline: none;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .cp-swatch {
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;
    }

    .cp-row,
    .cp-recent {
        gap: 3px;
    }
}

/* Lesson details */
.lesson-editor-details {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
}
.lesson-details-header h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.lesson-details-header p { margin: .2rem 0 0; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: .86rem; }
.lesson-details-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.5fr) minmax(280px, 1fr); gap: 1rem; margin-top: .9rem; }
.lesson-description-input { min-height: 96px; resize: vertical; }
.lesson-character-count { margin-top: .35rem; text-align: end; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: .76rem; }
.lesson-password-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; gap: .45rem; align-items: stretch; }
.lesson-password-action, .lesson-password-remove { min-height: 40px; min-width: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-primary); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; padding: .45rem .65rem; }
.lesson-password-action:hover, .lesson-password-remove:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.lesson-password-action:focus-visible, .lesson-password-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }
.lesson-password-footer { display: flex; gap: .65rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: .45rem; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: .8rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.lesson-password-remove { color: var(--color-error, #dc2626); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-error, #dc2626) 35%, var(--color-border)); }

@media (max-width: 720px) {
    .lesson-details-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .lesson-password-field { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }
    .lesson-password-action:last-child { grid-column: 2; }
}

/* Dropdowns are detached to <body> by global-markdown-toolbar.js. */
.gmd-dropdown-menu {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 10050;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 16px);
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
```

## `public/src/features/create-lesson/create-lesson.js`
```javascript
// =============================================================================
// public/src/features/create-lesson/create-lesson.js
// LESSON AUTHORING — /create-lesson page logic.
// =============================================================================
// See docs/plans/lessons-feature-plan.md's Phase 3.
//
// This page is deliberately a sibling of create-quiz.js and behaves like it:
//   * Lessons are created for EVERYONE (no admin gate) and are saved into the
//     user's own workspace "امتحاناتك" — the `user_quizzes` localStorage list —
//     exactly like a quiz. There is no course/folder picker: placement inside
//     امتحاناتك is done afterwards with the workspace's own move/organize UI.
//   * Auto-save keeps a draft row in `user_quizzes` (meta.type = "draft" while
//     work-in-progress, promoted to meta.type = "lesson" on حفظ), the same
//     lifecycle create-quiz uses.
//   * A single fixed global Markdown + LaTeX bar (#globalMdBar) formats
//     whichever .md-source textarea was focused last.
//   * Structural undo / redo (whole-lesson snapshots), Ctrl+S save, and a
//     rename-from-the-title-bar flow all match create-quiz.
//
// It does NOT import create-quiz.js (per the plan's explicit ⚠️): the few
// pieces that are shared in spirit (replaceTextareaRange, the
// global-bar dispatcher, the media-upload helper) are ported here.
//
// Content shape is the one lesson-schema.js's normalizeLessonContent() and
// api/_validateLesson.js define — `{ sections: [{ id, title, defaultHidden,
// blocks: [...] }] }` — so a local lesson can later be published server-side
// with no conversion. Embedded questions support BOTH kinds the validator
// knows: `questionKind: "mcq"` (options + correctIndex) and
// `questionKind: "essay"` (modelAnswer).
//
// ⚠️ Lessons are never scored: nothing in this file touches points / level /
// passed_quizzes_count.
// =============================================================================

import { getToken, isAdminAuthenticated } from "../../shared/adminAuth.js";
import { ensureSharedSupabaseClient } from "../../shared/supabaseClientRegistry.js";
import { getManifest, invalidateManifestCache } from "../../shared/quizManifest.js";
import { renderMarkdown } from "../../shared/markdown.js";
import { readEditorDrafts, upsertEditorDraft, removeEditorDraft, migrateWorkspaceDrafts } from "../../shared/editor-drafts.js";
import { escapeHtml } from "../home/escape-html.js";
import {
    showNotification,
    _confirm,
    _prompt,
} from "../../components/notifications/notifications.js";
import { normalizeLessonContent, hasLessonLevelCollision } from "../lesson/lesson-schema.js";
import { FONT_CHOICES, applyReaderPrefs } from "../lesson/lesson-reader-prefs.js";
import { sha256Hex, validateLessonPasswordInput } from "../lesson/lesson-access.js";
import { setupGlobalMarkdownToolbar } from "../../shared/global-markdown-toolbar.js";
import { applyMarkdownToolbarAction } from "../../shared/markdown-toolbar-actions.js";
import { createAIAgentFab } from "../../components/ai-agent/ai-agent.js";
import { CREATE_LESSON_PAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT } from "../../components/ai-agent/ai-agent-default-prompts.js";
import { CREATE_LESSON_PAGE_SUGGESTED_PROMPTS } from "../../components/ai-agent/ai-agent-suggested-prompts.js";

// =============================================================================
// STATE
// =============================================================================

/**
 * The lesson being authored. `fontId` is the author's optional reader
 * default (saved as reader_prefs_default); it is edited
 * from the Markdown bar, not from a form card.
 */
let lessonData = emptyLessonData();

/** id of the current draft row in user_quizzes (meta.type === "draft"), or null. */
let currentDraftId = null;
/** id of an already-saved local lesson row being edited (?edit=<id>), or null. */
let editingLessonId = null;

/** Published Supabase lesson currently open in the editor, if any. */
let publishedLessonId = null;

/** Public lesson rows used for the admin publishing picker and edit deep links. */
let sharedLessons = [];

/** `examList` from getManifest(), used by the quiz-reference picker. */
let quizExamList = [];

/** Set once on DOMContentLoaded — gates only media *upload* (links are for all). */
let isAdmin = false;

let autosaveTimeout = null;
let lessonPasswordDraft = "";
let lessonPasswordHashJob = 0;
let lessonPasswordHashPromise = Promise.resolve(null);

function newLocalId(prefix) {
    return `${prefix}${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
}

function emptyLessonData() {
    return {
        title: "",
        description: "",
        fontId: "default",
        passwordHash: null,
        passwordProtected: false,
        sections: [{ id: newLocalId("s"), title: "", defaultHidden: false, blocks: [] }],
    };
}

// Timestamp of the last programmatic dropdown open — used to ignore the scroll
// event that the browser fires as a side effect of that same tap on a
// horizontally-scrolling bar (identical guard to create-quiz.js).
let _lastMenuOpenAt = 0;
function _armMenuOpenGuard() {
    _lastMenuOpenAt = Date.now();
}

// =============================================================================
// LOCAL STORAGE MODEL — the "امتحاناتك" workspace
// =============================================================================
// Rows live in the same `user_quizzes` array quizzes/folders/courses use, so
// the workspace's collision, move, rename and trash machinery treats a lesson
// like any other item:
//
//   { id, meta: { type: "lesson" | "draft-lesson", title, parentId, createdAt,
//                 updatedAt, readerPrefs? }, lesson: { sections: [...] } }
//
// Drafts are tagged "draft-lesson" (not plain "draft") so create-quiz's entry
// screen — which lists every meta.type === "draft" row as a quiz draft —
// never mistakes an unfinished lesson for an unfinished quiz.

const USER_ITEMS_KEY = "user_quizzes";
const LESSON_TYPE = "lesson";
const LESSON_DRAFT_TYPE = "draft-lesson";

function _readUserItems() {
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(USER_ITEMS_KEY) || "[]");
        if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
        let changed = false;
        const cleaned = parsed.map((row) => {
            if (!row || (row.meta?.type !== LESSON_TYPE && row.meta?.type !== LESSON_DRAFT_TYPE) || row.meta?.readerPrefs?.highlightId == null) {
                return row;
            }
            const meta = { ...row.meta, readerPrefs: { ...row.meta.readerPrefs } };
            delete meta.readerPrefs.highlightId;
            changed = true;
            return { ...row, meta };
        });
        if (changed) localStorage.setItem(USER_ITEMS_KEY, JSON.stringify(cleaned));
        return cleaned;
    } catch {
        return [];
    }
}

function _writeUserItems(items) {
    localStorage.setItem(USER_ITEMS_KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
}

function _generateId(prefix) {
    return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
}

/** Strip editor-only keys (_localId) so what's persisted is the clean, validated shape. */
function serializeContent(data = lessonData) {
    return {
        sections: data.sections.map((section) => ({
            id: section.id,
            title: section.title,
            defaultHidden: Boolean(section.defaultHidden),
            blocks: section.blocks.map((block) => {
                const { _localId, ...clean } = block;
                return clean;
            }),
        })),
    };
}

function readerPrefsFromData(data = lessonData) {
    return { fontId: data.fontId || "default" };
}

/** Number of embedded questions — shown on the workspace tile like a question count. */
function countQuestions(data = lessonData) {
    let n = 0;
    for (const s of data.sections) for (const b of s.blocks) if (b.type === "question") n++;
    return n;
}

function buildRow(id, type, existing) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const content = serializeContent();
    return {
        ...(existing || {}),
        id,
        meta: {
            ...(existing?.meta || {}),
            type,
            title: lessonData.title.trim(),
            parentId: existing?.meta?.parentId ?? null,
            createdAt: existing?.meta?.createdAt || new Date().toLocaleString("en-US"),
            updatedAt: now,
            readerPrefs: readerPrefsFromData(),
            description: lessonData.description || "",
            passwordProtected: Boolean(lessonData.passwordProtected || lessonData.passwordHash),
        },
        stats: { questionCount: countQuestions(), sectionCount: lessonData.sections.length },
        lesson: content,
        passwordHash: lessonData.passwordHash || null,
        // `questions` stays an (empty) array so any workspace code that reads
        // `quiz.questions.length` on every row never throws on a lesson row.
        questions: [],
    };
}

// =============================================================================
// UNDO / REDO — whole-lesson snapshots (same mechanism as create-quiz.js)
// =============================================================================
// Scoped to STRUCTURAL edits only (add/remove/move a section or block, change
// a question's type/correct answer, toggle hidden, undo-worthy reader-default
// changes). Per-keystroke text edits are excluded on purpose: they would
// explode the stack and fight the textarea's own native Ctrl+Z, which already
// handles text-level undo.

const UNDO_STACK_LIMIT = 50;
let undoStack = [];
let redoStack = [];
let isRestoringHistory = false;

function cloneLessonData() {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(lessonData));
}

/** Call BEFORE mutating lessonData for a structural change. */
function pushHistorySnapshot() {
    if (isRestoringHistory) return;
    undoStack.push(cloneLessonData());
    if (undoStack.length > UNDO_STACK_LIMIT) undoStack.shift();
    redoStack = [];
    updateUndoRedoButtons();
}

function updateUndoRedoButtons() {
    const undoBtn = document.getElementById("undoBtn");
    const redoBtn = document.getElementById("redoBtn");
    if (undoBtn) undoBtn.disabled = undoStack.length === 0;
    if (redoBtn) redoBtn.disabled = redoStack.length === 0;
}

function resetHistory() {
    undoStack = [];
    redoStack = [];
    updateUndoRedoButtons();
}

function refreshEditorAfterHistoryChange() {
    renderSections();
    updateSectionNavigator();
    updateAppTitleBar();
    // Undoing/redoing a reader-default change restores lessonData.fontId, but
    // the <select> in the Markdown bar is not part of renderSections() — sync
    // it or the control keeps showing the pre-undo value.
    syncReaderDefaultsBar();
}

window.performUndo = function () {
    if (undoStack.length === 0) return;
    const previous = undoStack.pop();
    redoStack.push(cloneLessonData());
    if (redoStack.length > UNDO_STACK_LIMIT) redoStack.shift();

    isRestoringHistory = true;
    lessonData = previous;
    refreshEditorAfterHistoryChange();
    isRestoringHistory = false;

    updateUndoRedoButtons();
    autosave();
};

window.performRedo = function () {
    if (redoStack.length === 0) return;
    const next = redoStack.pop();
    undoStack.push(cloneLessonData());
    if (undoStack.length > UNDO_STACK_LIMIT) undoStack.shift();

    isRestoringHistory = true;
    lessonData = next;
    refreshEditorAfterHistoryChange();
    isRestoringHistory = false;

    updateUndoRedoButtons();
    autosave();
};

// =============================================================================
// AUTOSAVE — debounced write of the working lesson into user_quizzes
// =============================================================================
// Same lifecycle as create-quiz.js:
//   * a brand-new lesson autosaves as a "draft-lesson" row (currentDraftId);
//   * editing an already-saved lesson (?edit=<id> / opened from the entry
//     grid) autosaves straight back onto THAT row (editingLessonId), keeping
//     its type "lesson", its parentId (so it stays where the user filed it)
//     and its createdAt — so a refresh never loses edits and never demotes a
//     saved lesson back to a draft.
// "حفظ الدرس" then promotes a draft to a real lesson (with the same-level name
// collision check) and returns to the entry grid.

function autosave() {
    clearTimeout(autosaveTimeout);
    updateAutosaveIndicator("saving");

    autosaveTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        try {
            // Published lessons are only written through the authenticated
            // admin action on an explicit save/publish. Never silently turn
            // a shared lesson edit into a private browser draft.
            if (publishedLessonId) {
                updateAutosaveIndicator("saved");
                return;
            }
            const items = _readUserItems();

            if (editingLessonId) {
                const idx = items.findIndex((r) => r.id === editingLessonId);
                if (idx >= 0) {
                    items[idx] = buildRow(editingLessonId, items[idx].meta?.type || LESSON_TYPE, items[idx]);
                    // An existing lesson's autosave must not fail just because
                    // the title is temporarily blank/duplicate mid-edit — the
                    // collision check is enforced on the explicit save.
                    _writeUserItems(items);
                }
            } else {
                if (!currentDraftId) currentDraftId = _generateId("draft-lesson");
                const existing = readEditorDrafts().find((r) => r.id === currentDraftId);
                upsertEditorDraft(buildRow(currentDraftId, LESSON_DRAFT_TYPE, existing));
            }
            updateAutosaveIndicator("saved");
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Autosave error:", error);
            updateAutosaveIndicator("error");
        }
    }, 1000);
}

function updateAutosaveIndicator(status) {
    const indicator = document.getElementById("autosaveIndicator");
    if (!indicator) return;
    indicator.classList.remove("saving", "error");
    const label = indicator.querySelector(".save-text");
    if (status === "saving") {
        indicator.classList.add("saving");
        if (label) label.textContent = "يُحفظ..";
    } else if (status === "saved") {
        if (label) label.textContent = "محفوظ";
    } else if (status === "error") {
        indicator.classList.add("error");
        if (label) label.textContent = "خطأ في الحفظ";
    }
}

/** Flush a pending debounce immediately (used before leaving the editor). */
function flushAutosave() {
    if (!autosaveTimeout) return;
    clearTimeout(autosaveTimeout);
    autosaveTimeout = null;
    try {
        if (publishedLessonId) {
            updateAutosaveIndicator("saved");
            return;
        }
        const items = _readUserItems();
        if (editingLessonId) {
            const idx = items.findIndex((r) => r.id === editingLessonId);
            if (idx >= 0) {
                items[idx] = buildRow(editingLessonId, items[idx].meta?.type || LESSON_TYPE, items[idx]);
                _writeUserItems(items);
            }
        } else {
            if (!currentDraftId) currentDraftId = _generateId("draft-lesson");
            const existing = readEditorDrafts().find((r) => r.id === currentDraftId);
            upsertEditorDraft(buildRow(currentDraftId, LESSON_DRAFT_TYPE, existing));
        }
        updateAutosaveIndicator("saved");
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Autosave flush error:", error);
        updateAutosaveIndicator("error");
    }
}

// Persist any pending edit if the tab is closed / navigated away within the
// 1s debounce window — autosave() alone would lose those last keystrokes.
window.addEventListener("pagehide", flushAutosave);
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") flushAutosave();
});

// =============================================================================
// INIT
// =============================================================================

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {
    migrateWorkspaceDrafts();
    isAdmin = isAdminAuthenticated();

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const editId = urlParams.get("edit");

    setupGlobalMdBar();
    setupKeyboardShortcuts();
    setupEntryItemMenuListeners();
    setupSectionNavigatorToggle();
    setupReaderDefaultsBar();
    updateUndoRedoButtons();
    loadQuizExamList();

    // Wrapped defensively: an old-schema/corrupt draft (e.g. a block shape
    // that predates this feature) can throw while normalizing or rendering.
    // Routing fix (vercel.json) stops the *wrong-page* symptom (browser nav
    // to /create-lesson was being caught by the SPA catch-all and bounced to
    // "/"), but a genuinely bad row can still throw client-side once we're
    // on the right page — this catch is what sends that case to the entry
    // screen instead of leaving a half-rendered/broken editor.
    let openedOk = false;
    if (editId) {
        try {
            openedOk = openLessonById(editId);
            if (!openedOk && isAdmin) openedOk = await openPublishedLessonById(editId);
        } catch (err) {
            console.error("Failed to open lesson for editing:", err);
            openedOk = false;
        }
    }

    if (!openedOk) {
        if (isAdmin) await loadSharedLessons();
        showEntryScreen();
    } else {
        // Deep-linked edit bypasses the entry screen, same as create-quiz.
    }

    document.dispatchEvent(new Event("app:ready"));
});

window.toggleLessonMenu = function (event, id) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    const menu = document.getElementById(id);
    const open = menu?.classList.contains("open");
    document.querySelectorAll("#menuBar .menu-dropdown.open").forEach((item) => item.classList.remove("open"));
    if (menu && !open) menu.classList.add("open");
};

window.lessonMenuAction = function (action) {
    document.querySelectorAll("#menuBar .menu-dropdown.open").forEach((item) => item.classList.remove("open"));
    if (action === "save") return window.saveLesson();
    if (action === "preview") return window.previewLesson();
    if (action === "section") return window.addSection();
    if (action === "help") return showNotification("اختصارات", "Ctrl+S للحفظ، Ctrl+Z للتراجع، Ctrl+Y للإعادة.", "info");
    const section = lessonData.sections[lessonData.sections.length - 1];
    if (["markdown", "media", "question", "quizRef", "lesson-reference"].includes(action) && section) return window.addBlock(section.id, action);
    if (action === "expand" || action === "collapse") {
        document.querySelectorAll(".lesson-section-card").forEach((card) => card.classList.toggle("collapsed", action === "collapse"));
    }
};

document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    if (!event.target.closest("#menuBar")) {
        document.querySelectorAll("#menuBar .menu-dropdown.open").forEach((item) => item.classList.remove("open"));
    }
});

async function loadQuizExamList() {
    try {
        const { examList } = await getManifest();
        quizExamList = Array.isArray(examList) ? examList : [];
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("[create-lesson] failed to load quiz manifest:", err);
        quizExamList = [];
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// ENTRY SCREEN — recent drafts + saved lessons (from user_quizzes, like create-quiz)
// =============================================================================

function showEntryScreen() {
    flushAutosave();
    const entryScreen = document.getElementById("entryScreen");
    const form = document.getElementById("lessonCreatorForm");
    const appTitleBar = document.getElementById("appTitleBar");
    const globalMdBar = document.getElementById("globalMdBar");

    if (form) form.style.display = "none";
    if (appTitleBar) appTitleBar.style.display = "none";
    if (globalMdBar) globalMdBar.style.display = "none";
    if (entryScreen) entryScreen.style.display = "block";
    document.body.classList.remove("lesson-form-active");

    // Drop ?edit= now that the editor is closed, so the address bar never
    // points at a lesson that's no longer open.
    if (window.location.search) {
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        if (url.searchParams.has("edit")) {
            url.searchParams.delete("edit");
            history.replaceState(null, "", url.pathname + url.search);
        }
    }

    renderEntryItemsGrid();
}

function showLessonForm() {
    const entryScreen = document.getElementById("entryScreen");
    const form = document.getElementById("lessonCreatorForm");
    const appTitleBar = document.getElementById("appTitleBar");
    const globalMdBar = document.getElementById("globalMdBar");
    if (entryScreen) entryScreen.style.display = "none";
    if (form) form.style.display = "flex";
    if (appTitleBar) appTitleBar.style.display = "flex";
    if (globalMdBar) globalMdBar.style.display = "flex";
    document.body.classList.add("lesson-form-active");
    updateAppTitleBar();
    mountCreatorAgent();
}

function lessonEditorContext() {
    return {
        title: lessonData.title || "درس بدون عنوان",
        sections: lessonData.sections.map((section, index) => ({
            title: section.title || `قسم ${index + 1}`,
            blockCount: section.blocks.length,
        })),
    };
}

function addLessonQuestionFromAgent(toolCall) {
    if (toolCall?.name !== "add_lesson_question") throw new Error("Unknown lesson editor tool");
    const input = toolCall.input || {};
    const prompt = String(input.prompt || "").trim();
    if (!prompt) throw new Error("Question prompt is required");
    const target = input.sectionTitle
        ? lessonData.sections.find((section) => section.title === input.sectionTitle)
        : lessonData.sections[0];
    if (!target) {
        const error = new Error("Section not found");
        error.userMessage = "تعذر العثور على القسم المطلوب لإضافة السؤال.";
        throw error;
    }
    const isEssay = input.questionKind === "essay";
    const options = Array.isArray(input.options) ? input.options.map((option) => String(option || "").trim()) : [];
    const correctIndexes = Array.isArray(input.correctIndexes) ? input.correctIndexes.map(Number) : [0];
    if (isEssay && !String(input.modelAnswer || "").trim()) {
        const error = new Error("Essay model answer is required");
        error.userMessage = "السؤال المقالي يحتاج إجابة نموذجية.";
        throw error;
    }
    if (!isEssay && (options.length < 2 || correctIndexes.some((index) => !Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= options.length))) {
        const error = new Error("Invalid MCQ options");
        error.userMessage = "السؤال يحتاج خيارين صالحين وإجابة صحيحة.";
        throw error;
    }
    pushHistorySnapshot();
    target.blocks.push(isEssay
        ? { type: "question", id: newLocalId("q"), _localId: newLocalId("b"), questionKind: "essay", prompt, modelAnswer: String(input.modelAnswer).trim(), explanation: String(input.explanation || "") }
        : { type: "question", id: newLocalId("q"), _localId: newLocalId("b"), questionKind: "mcq", prompt, options, correctIndex: correctIndexes[0], multiSelect: Boolean(input.multiSelect), correctIndexes, explanation: String(input.explanation || "") });
    renderSections();
    autosave();
    showNotification("تمت الإضافة", `أُضيف السؤال إلى ${target.title || "القسم الأول"}.`, "success");
    return `✅ تمت إضافة السؤال إلى ${target.title || "القسم الأول"}.`;
}

function mountCreatorAgent() {
    if (document.querySelector(".create-lesson-agent-fab")) return;
    const fab = createAIAgentFab({
        pageKey: "create-lesson",
        placeholder: "اطلب من الباشــمبصمج مساعدتك في هذا الدرس",
        defaultSystemPrompt: CREATE_LESSON_PAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
        suggestedPrompts: CREATE_LESSON_PAGE_SUGGESTED_PROMPTS,
        contextSummary: lessonEditorContext,
        enableTools: true,
        enableFileUpload: true,
        toolNames: ["add_lesson_question"],
        onToolCall: addLessonQuestionFromAgent,
    });
    fab.classList.add("create-lesson-agent-fab");
    document.body.appendChild(fab);
}

function formatEntryItemDate(isoString) {
    if (!isoString) return "";
    const date = new Date(isoString);
    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
    const diffMin = Math.floor((Date.now() - date.getTime()) / 60000);
    if (diffMin < 1) return "الآن";
    if (diffMin < 60) return `منذ ${diffMin} دقيقة`;
    const diffHr = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
    if (diffHr < 24) return `منذ ${diffHr} ساعة`;
    const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHr / 24);
    if (diffDay < 30) return `منذ ${diffDay} يوم`;
    return date.toLocaleDateString("ar-EG", { year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}

function _byNewest(a, b) {
    if (!a.updatedAt && !b.updatedAt) return 0;
    if (!a.updatedAt) return 1;
    if (!b.updatedAt) return -1;
    return new Date(b.updatedAt) - new Date(a.updatedAt);
}

function renderEntryItemsGrid() {
    const grid = document.getElementById("entryItemsGrid");
    if (!grid) return;

    const items = _readUserItems();
    const draftItems = readEditorDrafts();
    const toTile = (row, kind) => ({
        kind,
        id: row.id,
        title: row.meta?.title || (kind === "draft" ? "مسودة غير مُعنونة" : "درس بدون عنوان"),
        count: row.stats?.questionCount ?? 0,
        sections: row.stats?.sectionCount ?? row.lesson?.sections?.length ?? 0,
        updatedAt: row.meta?.updatedAt || null,
    });

    const drafts = draftItems
        .filter((r) => r.meta?.type === LESSON_DRAFT_TYPE)
        .map((r) => toTile(r, "draft"))
        .sort(_byNewest);
    const saved = items
        .filter((r) => r.meta?.type === LESSON_TYPE)
        .map((r) => toTile(r, "mine"))
        .sort(_byNewest);
    const published = sharedLessons
        .map((row) => ({
            kind: "published",
            id: row.id,
            title: row.title || "درس بدون عنوان",
            count: 0,
            sections: 0,
            description: row.description || "",
            updatedAt: row.updated_at || row.created_at || null,
        }))
        .sort(_byNewest);

    const makeTile = (item) => {
        const meta = [
            `${item.sections} ${item.sections === 1 ? "قسم" : "أقسام"}`,
            formatEntryItemDate(item.updatedAt),
        ]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join(" · ");
        const id = escapeHtml(item.id);
        return `
      <div class="entry-item-wrap">
        <button type="button" class="entry-item${item.kind === "draft" ? " entry-item-draft" : ""}" onclick="${item.kind === "published" ? "choosePublishedLessonToEdit" : "chooseUserLessonToEdit"}('${id}')">
          <span class="entry-item-thumb">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
              <path d="M12 7v14" />
              <path d="M3 18a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h5a4 4 0 0 1 4 4 4 4 0 0 1 4-4h5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v13a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-6a3 3 0 0 0-3 3 3 3 0 0 0-3-3z" />
            </svg>
          </span>
          <span class="entry-item-title">${escapeHtml(item.title)}</span>
          <span class="entry-item-meta">${escapeHtml(meta)}</span>
        </button>
        ${item.kind === "published" ? "" : `<div class="entry-item-more-wrap">
          <button type="button" class="entry-item-more-btn" onclick="toggleEntryItemMenu(event, '${id}')" aria-label="خيارات إضافية" title="خيارات إضافية">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1" /><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1" /><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1" /></svg>
          </button>
          <div class="entry-item-menu" id="entryItemMenu-${id}">
            <button type="button" class="entry-item-menu-option" onclick="renameEntryItem(event, '${id}')">
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M17 3a2.85 2.83 0 1 1 4 4L7.5 20.5 2 22l1.5-5.5Z" /></svg>
              <span>إعادة تسمية</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="entry-item-menu-option entry-item-menu-option-danger" onclick="deleteEntryItem(event, '${id}')">
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 6h18" /><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6" /><path d="M8 6V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2" /></svg>
              <span>حذف</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>`}
      </div>`;
    };

    let html = "";
    if (drafts.length) {
        html += `<div class="entry-section"><h2 class="entry-screen-heading">المسودات</h2><div class="entry-items-grid">${drafts.map(makeTile).join("")}</div></div>`;
    }
    if (saved.length) {
        html += `<div class="entry-section"><h2 class="entry-screen-heading">الدروس المحفوظة</h2><div class="entry-items-grid">${saved.map(makeTile).join("")}</div></div>`;
    }
    if (published.length) {
        html += `<div class="entry-section"><h2 class="entry-screen-heading">الدروس المنشورة</h2><div class="entry-items-grid">${published.map(makeTile).join("")}</div></div>`;
    }
    grid.innerHTML = html;

    const skeleton = document.getElementById("entrySkeleton");
    if (skeleton) skeleton.style.display = "none";
    grid.style.display = "";
}

// ── Entry-tile ⋮ menu: rename / delete ───────────────────────────────────────

window.toggleEntryItemMenu = function (event, id) {
    event.stopPropagation();
    const menu = document.getElementById(`entryItemMenu-${id}`);
    if (!menu) return;
    const wasOpen = menu.classList.contains("open");
    closeAllEntryItemMenus();
    if (!wasOpen) menu.classList.add("open");
};

function closeAllEntryItemMenus() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".entry-item-menu.open").forEach((m) => m.classList.remove("open"));
}

function setupEntryItemMenuListeners() {
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (!e.target.closest(".entry-item-more-wrap")) closeAllEntryItemMenus();
    });
}
```
