```css
.lesson-info-modal__prefs-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .7rem;
}

.lesson-info-modal__prefs-grid > label {
  display: grid;
  gap: .35rem;
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .82rem;
}

.lesson-info-modal__prefs-grid select,
.lesson-info-modal__prefs-grid input:not([type="checkbox"]) {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: .55rem .65rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: var(--color-surface, transparent);
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
}

.lesson-info-modal__prefs-grid select option {
  background: var(--color-surface);
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.lesson-info-modal__prefs-switch {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto !important;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 2.35rem;
  padding: .45rem .65rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 9px;
}

.lesson-info-modal__prefs-switch input[type="checkbox"] {
  width: 1.1rem;
  height: 1.1rem;
  margin: 0;
  accent-color: var(--color-primary);
}

/* ── Robust read-aloud toolbar ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.lesson-tts {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .45rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}

.lesson-tts__btn {
  min-height: 36px;
}

.lesson-tts__btn--stop[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

.lesson-tts__speed {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .35rem;
  min-height: 36px;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .8rem;
}

.lesson-tts__speed-select {
  min-width: 4.1rem;
  padding: .35rem .45rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--color-surface);
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
}

.lesson-tts__status {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 20rem;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .76rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.lesson-tts__status.is-loading {
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.lesson-tts__status.is-error {
  color: var(--color-danger, #dc2626);
}

.lesson-tts--unsupported .lesson-tts__status {
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.lesson-tts-block--active {
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--color-primary-light, rgb(99 102 241 / .13));
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-light, rgb(99 102 241 / .08));
  transition: background-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
}

/* ── Interactive embedded questions ───────────────────────────────────── */
.lesson-question {
  padding: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--color-surface, transparent);
}

.lesson-question__options {
  display: grid;
  gap: .55rem;
  margin-top: .8rem;
}

.lesson-question__option {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .7rem;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-height: 3rem;
  padding: .65rem .75rem;
  text-align: start;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.lesson-question__option-text {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.lesson-question__option.is-selected {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-primary-light, rgb(99 102 241 / .1));
}

.lesson-question__option.is-correct {
  border-color: var(--color-success, #22c55e);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success, #22c55e) 12%, transparent);
}

.lesson-question__option.is-wrong {
  border-color: var(--color-danger, #ef4444);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-danger, #ef4444) 12%, transparent);
}

.lesson-question__check-btn,
.lesson-question__essay-check-btn {
  margin-top: .75rem;
}

/* ── Advanced ephemeral AI quiz ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.lesson-ai-quiz {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 2rem 0 0;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.35rem);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 70%, var(--color-border));
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: var(--color-surface, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / .045);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: start;
  gap: .8rem;
  margin: 0;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__heading {
  min-width: 0;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 1.55rem;
  padding: .15rem .55rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--color-primary-light, rgb(99 102 241 / .12));
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font-size: .74rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__header h2 {
  margin: .4rem 0 0;
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2.4vw, 1.35rem);
  line-height: 1.5;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__header p {
  margin: .25rem 0 0;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .8rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__close {
  display: inline-flex;
  cursor: pointer;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary) !important;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__close:hover {
  color: var(--color-text-primary) !important;
  border-color: var(--color-primary) !important;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__meta {
  display: grid;
  gap: .55rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: .8rem .9rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-hover, transparent) 70%, transparent);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__progress-line {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .7rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .8rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__progress-track {
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--color-border);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__progress-track > span {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: var(--color-primary);
  transition: width .2s ease;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .35rem;
  direction: rtl;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__nav-dot {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: .65rem;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: .78rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__nav-dot:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__nav-dot.is-answered {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 45%, var(--color-border));
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__nav-dot.is-active {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  color: #fff;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__question {
  min-width: 0;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: clamp(.95rem, 2vw, 1.2rem);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__question-kicker {
  margin-bottom: .45rem;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__question h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.25vw, 1.25rem);
  line-height: 1.75;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__options {
  display: grid;
  gap: .55rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2rem auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: .65rem;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: .7rem .75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: start;
  transition: border-color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-surface-hover, rgb(127 127 127 / .06));
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option input {
  margin: 0;
  accent-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option-index {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 1.9rem;
  height: 1.9rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: .55rem;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option-text {
  min-width: 0;
  line-height: 1.65;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option.is-selected {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-primary-light, rgb(99 102 241 / .1));
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary-light, rgb(99 102 241 / .08));
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option.is-correct-option {
  border-color: var(--color-success, #22c55e);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success, #22c55e) 12%, transparent);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option.is-wrong-option {
  border-color: var(--color-danger, #ef4444);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-danger, #ef4444) 12%, transparent);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__text-wrap {
  display: grid;
  gap: .45rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__text-label {
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__text {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: .8rem .85rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  background: var(--color-surface);
  font: inherit;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__text:focus-visible,
.lesson-ai-quiz__option:focus-within {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, var(--color-primary));
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__feedback {
  margin-top: .9rem;
  padding: .75rem .85rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: var(--color-surface-hover, rgb(127 127 127 / .07));
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__feedback-title {
  font-weight: 750;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__feedback p {
  margin: .35rem 0 0;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.65;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__feedback.is-correct {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success, #22c55e) 45%, var(--color-border));
  color: var(--color-success, #16803d);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__feedback.is-incorrect {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-danger, #ef4444) 45%, var(--color-border));
  color: var(--color-danger, #c0392b);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__feedback-note {
  font-size: .78rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .75rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__steps {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .5rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__step,
.lesson-ai-quiz__submit {
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: .55rem .9rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 650;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__submit {
  border-color: transparent;
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: #fff;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__step:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__submit:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--color-primary-hover, var(--color-primary));
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__step:disabled,
.lesson-ai-quiz__submit:disabled {
  opacity: .5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__close:focus-visible,
.lesson-ai-quiz__nav-dot:focus-visible,
.lesson-ai-quiz__step:focus-visible,
.lesson-ai-quiz__submit:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, var(--color-primary));
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ── Selection-popup loading/error state ───────────────────────────────── */
.lesson-selection-popup {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .4rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  max-width: min(90vw, 32rem);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.lesson-selection-popup__btn:disabled {
  opacity: .6;
  cursor: wait;
}

.lesson-selection-popup__status {
  flex: 1 1 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .74rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.lesson-selection-popup__status.is-error {
  color: var(--color-danger, #dc2626);
}

/* ── Loading skeleton ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.lesson-view--loading {
  width: min(100%, 1180px);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem) clamp(.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem) 5rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  text-align: start;
}

.lesson-skeleton__header,
.lesson-skeleton__layout,
.lesson-skeleton__section,
.lesson-skeleton__question {
  min-width: 0;
}

.lesson-skeleton__header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(220px, auto);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--color-surface, transparent);
}

.lesson-skeleton__header-copy,
.lesson-skeleton__header-actions,
.lesson-skeleton__section,
.lesson-skeleton__question,
.lesson-skeleton__options {
  display: grid;
  align-content: start;
  gap: .65rem;
}

.lesson-skeleton__header-actions {
  grid-auto-flow: column;
  grid-auto-columns: minmax(64px, 1fr);
}

.lesson-skeleton__layout {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
}

.lesson-skeleton__content {
  width: min(100%, 820px);
  margin-inline: auto;
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.lesson-skeleton__section {
  padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: var(--color-surface, transparent);
}

.lesson-skeleton__question {
  margin-top: .15rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.lesson-skeleton__toc {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 50% auto auto 28px;
  width: 200px;
  padding: 14px 10px;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  display: grid;
  gap: .55rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--color-surface, transparent);
}

.lesson-skeleton__line {
  display: block;
  width: var(--skeleton-width, 70%);
  max-width: 100%;
  height: .85rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-surface-hover, rgb(127 127 127 / .1)) 0%, var(--color-border) 50%, var(--color-surface-hover, rgb(127 127 127 / .1)) 100%);
  background-size: 220% 100%;
  animation: lesson-shimmer 1.45s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.lesson-skeleton__line--2 { height: 1.35rem; }
.lesson-skeleton__line--3 { opacity: .88; }
.lesson-skeleton__line--4 { opacity: .72; }
.lesson-skeleton__media {
  min-height: 9rem;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-surface-hover, rgb(127 127 127 / .1)) 0%, var(--color-border) 50%, var(--color-surface-hover, rgb(127 127 127 / .1)) 100%);
  background-size: 220% 100%;
  animation: lesson-shimmer 1.45s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes lesson-shimmer {
  0% { background-position: 100% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -120% 0; }
}

.lesson-load-error {
  width: min(100%, 720px);
  margin: clamp(2rem, 8vh, 5rem) auto;
  padding: 2rem 1.25rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: var(--color-surface, transparent);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.lesson-load-error__icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 2.8rem;
  height: 2.8rem;
  margin: 0 auto 1rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--color-primary-light, rgb(99 102 241 / .1));
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font-weight: 800;
}

.lesson-load-error h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.lesson-load-error p {
  margin: .6rem auto 0;
  max-width: 32rem;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.lesson-load-error__actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: .6rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.lesson-view__retry-btn,
.lesson-view__back-btn {
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: .55rem .9rem;
  border-radius: 9px;
  font: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.lesson-view__retry-btn {
  border: 0;
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.lesson-view__back-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .lesson-view__header {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lesson-view__heading,
  .lesson-view__header-actions {
    grid-column: 1;
  }
  .lesson-view__header-actions {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }
  .lesson-view__header-actions > .lesson-prefs,
  .lesson-view__header-actions > .lesson-bookmarks {
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .lesson-skeleton__header {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lesson-skeleton__header-actions {
    grid-auto-flow: row;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .lesson-skeleton__toc {
    display: none;
  }
  .lesson-ai-quiz__footer {
    align-items: stretch;
  }
  .lesson-ai-quiz__steps,
  .lesson-ai-quiz__submit {
    width: 100%;
  }
  .lesson-ai-quiz__steps > * {
    flex: 1 1 0;
  }
  .lesson-info-modal__prefs-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .lesson-view--loading * {
    animation: none !important;
  }
  .lesson-tts-block--active,
  .lesson-ai-quiz__progress-track > span {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}
/* ── Final AI quiz layout pass ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.lesson-ai-quiz {
  margin: 1.25rem 0 0;
  padding: clamp(.9rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__header {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-inline-end: 3rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__heading {
  min-width: 0;
  text-align: start;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__header p {
  max-width: 52rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__close {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-end: 0;
  inset-block-start: 0;
  width: 2.35rem;
  height: 2.35rem;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__meta {
  margin-top: .8rem;
  padding: .7rem .8rem;
  gap: .45rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__progress-line {
  font-size: .78rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__nav {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: .3rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__nav-dot {
  width: 1.9rem;
  height: 1.9rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__question {
  margin-top: .8rem;
  padding: clamp(.85rem, 2vw, 1.1rem);
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__question h3 {
  max-width: 70ch;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__options {
  gap: .5rem;
  margin-top: .85rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option {
  grid-template-columns: 2rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: .6rem;
  min-height: 2.9rem;
  padding: .62rem .7rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option-text {
  text-align: start;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__option input {
  width: 1.05rem;
  height: 1.05rem;
  justify-self: end;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__text-wrap {
  margin-top: .85rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .75rem;
  margin-top: .85rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__submit {
  order: 2;
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 10.5rem;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__steps {
  order: 1;
  direction: rtl;
}

.lesson-ai-quiz__step {
  min-width: 5.7rem;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .lesson-ai-quiz__header {
    padding-inline-end: 2.8rem;
  }

  .lesson-ai-quiz__footer {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .lesson-ai-quiz__submit,
  .lesson-ai-quiz__steps {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .lesson-ai-quiz__submit {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .lesson-ai-quiz__steps > * {
    flex: 1 1 0;
  }
}

.lesson-skeleton__sr {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

/* Skeleton geometry mirrors the real .doc-toc rail on desktop and the
   same compact flow on phones; the actual ToC stylesheet takes over once
   lesson data is painted. */
.lesson-skeleton__toc {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-height: 70vh;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.lesson-skeleton__toc-toggle {
  display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .lesson-view--loading {
    padding-bottom: calc(5rem + var(--bottom-nav-height, 54px));
  }
  .lesson-skeleton__content {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .lesson-skeleton__toc {
    display: none;
  }

  .lesson-skeleton__toc-toggle {
    position: fixed;
    inset-inline-start: 1rem;
    inset-block-end: calc(1rem + var(--bottom-nav-height, 54px));
    z-index: 40;
    display: grid;
    width: 2.9rem;
    height: 2.9rem;
    place-items: center;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color, rgba(127, 127, 127, .25));
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--color-surface, var(--color-bg, #fff));
    box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
  }

  .lesson-skeleton__toc-toggle::before,
  .lesson-skeleton__toc-toggle::after,
  .lesson-skeleton__toc-toggle i {
    content: "";
    display: block;
    width: 1rem;
    height: .11rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--color-text-secondary, #8a8f98);
    box-shadow: 0 .28rem 0 var(--color-text-secondary, #8a8f98), 0 -.28rem 0 var(--color-text-secondary, #8a8f98);
  }
}


/* ── Lesson reader header — compact two-row control bar ───────────────────── */
.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: .8rem;
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
  padding: .9rem 1rem 1rem;
  overflow: visible;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--color-surface, Canvas);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .045);
  isolation: isolate;
  z-index: 30;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-block: 12px;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  width: 3px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--color-primary);
}

/* Row 1: lesson identity + title/description. */
.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header-main {
  min-width: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: .35rem;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header-topline {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .75rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .4rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__eyebrow-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 1.65rem;
  height: 1.65rem;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 28%, var(--color-border));
  border-radius: .55rem;
  background: var(--color-primary-light, rgba(99, 102, 241, .10));
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__eyebrow-icon .lesson-icon {
  width: .95rem;
  height: .95rem;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .35rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__meta-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 24px;
  padding: .14rem .5rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--color-background-secondary, var(--color-surface));
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__heading {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  text-align: start;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__title {
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2.7vw, 1.85rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -.018em;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__subtitle {
  max-width: 65rem;
  margin: .18rem 0 0;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: .82rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* Row 2: a single no-wrap toolbar. It deliberately has no overflow clipping
   so its preference/bookmark panels can escape the card. */
.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header-actions {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: .45rem;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-top: .65rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  overflow: visible;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-header__action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: .42rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: .45rem .72rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: .65rem;
  background: var(--color-surface, Canvas);
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, color .16s ease, transform .16s ease;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-header__action:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 48%, var(--color-border));
  background: var(--color-primary-light, rgba(99, 102, 241, .10));
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-header__action:active {
  transform: translateY(1px);
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-header__action:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, var(--color-primary));
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-header__action .lesson-icon {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__info-btn {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 22%, transparent);
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__info-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-primary-hover, var(--color-primary));
  background: var(--color-primary-hover, var(--color-primary));
  color: #fff;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-reset-all {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-prefs,
.lesson-view--reader .lesson-bookmarks {
  position: relative;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-width: 0;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-prefs__toggle,
.lesson-view--reader .lesson-bookmarks__toggle {
  border-color: var(--color-border);
  background: var(--color-surface, Canvas);
  color: var(--color-text-primary);
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-prefs__toggle[aria-expanded="true"],
.lesson-view--reader .lesson-bookmarks__toggle[aria-expanded="true"] {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-primary-light, rgba(99, 102, 241, .10));
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

/* Existing preference/bookmark content is unchanged; only the shell is
   restyled here. The menus intentionally sit above the following lesson
   section rather than being clipped by the compact header. */
.lesson-view--reader .lesson-prefs__panel,
.lesson-view--reader .lesson-bookmarks__panel {
  z-index: 1000;
  max-width: min(340px, calc(100vw - 1rem));
  border-color: var(--color-border);
  border-radius: .8rem;
  background: var(--color-surface, Canvas);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgb(0 0 0 / .16);
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-prefs__panel {
  min-width: 250px;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-bookmarks__panel {
  width: min(22rem, calc(100vw - 1rem));
}

/* Dynamic title direction: `dir` is assigned by lesson-view.js from the first
   strong character, so Arabic titles are right-aligned and English titles are
   left-aligned without hard-coding one direction into the component. */
.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__title[dir="rtl"] {
  text-align: right;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__title[dir="ltr"] {
  text-align: left;
}

.lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__title[dir="auto"] {
  text-align: start;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header {
    gap: .65rem;
    padding: .8rem .85rem .9rem;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header-topline {
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__eyebrow-icon {
    width: 1.55rem;
    height: 1.55rem;
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__title {
    font-size: clamp(1.22rem, 5.7vw, 1.55rem);
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__subtitle {
    font-size: .78rem;
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header-actions {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-header__action {
    width: 38px;
    min-width: 38px;
    padding-inline: 0;
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-header__action-label {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header {
    padding-inline: .7rem;
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__header-actions {
    gap: .35rem;
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__meta-item {
    font-size: .66rem;
  }

  .lesson-view--reader .lesson-view__eyebrow {
    font-size: .72rem;
  }
}

/* The inline first-paint skeleton should occupy the same geometry as the
   JavaScript-rendered loading skeleton, with no delayed "flash" transition. */
.lesson-view--initial-skeleton {
  min-height: min(72vh, 760px);
}

.lesson-view--initial-skeleton .lesson-skeleton__header {
  min-height: 86px;
}

.lesson-view--initial-skeleton .lesson-skeleton__layout {
  min-height: 480px;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .lesson-view--initial-skeleton .lesson-skeleton__layout {
    min-height: 360px;
  }
}

/* Keep the three selection actions comfortably tappable on narrow screens. */
.lesson-selection-popup__btn {
  min-height: 38px;
}

@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .lesson-selection-popup {
    gap: .3rem;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 16px);
  }

  .lesson-selection-popup__btn {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;
    padding-inline: .6rem;
    font-size: .8rem;
  }
}


/* ── Embedded quiz/lesson references ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.lesson-ref-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 88%, transparent);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm, 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06));
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lesson-ref-card__main { display: flex; gap: .8rem; min-width: 0; align-items: flex-start; }
.lesson-ref-card__icon {
  width: 42px; height: 42px; flex: 0 0 42px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-primary-light); color: var(--color-primary);
}
.lesson-ref-card--lesson .lesson-ref-card__icon { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success) 14%, var(--color-surface)); color: var(--color-success); }
.lesson-ref-card__icon svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; }
.lesson-ref-card__copy { min-width: 0; }
.lesson-ref-card__label, .lesson-ref-card__count { display: block; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: .78rem; }
.lesson-ref-card__title { margin: .18rem 0; font-size: 1rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lesson-ref-card__description, .lesson-ref-card__unavailable { margin: .2rem 0 0; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: .84rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.lesson-ref-card__protected { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; margin-top: .35rem; color: var(--color-warning, #b45309); font-size: .78rem; }
.lesson-ref-card__protected svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.lesson-ref-card__actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(72px, auto)); gap: .4rem; align-self: stretch; align-items: center; }
.lesson-ref-card__action { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .35rem; padding: .45rem .55rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-primary); font: inherit; font-size: .8rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
.lesson-ref-card__action:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary); }
.lesson-ref-card__action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }
.lesson-ref-card__action svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: 0 0 16px; }
.lesson-ref-card__action:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }
.lesson-ref-card.is-unavailable .lesson-ref-card__action--start,
.lesson-ref-card.is-unavailable .lesson-ref-card__action--download,
.lesson-ref-card.is-unavailable .lesson-ref-card__action--ask { pointer-events: none; }

/* ── Lesson password gate ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.lesson-password-dialog { border: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-primary); width: min(92vw, 460px); max-width: 460px; }
.lesson-password-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(15, 23, 42, .72); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
.lesson-password-dialog__panel { display: grid; gap: .75rem; padding: 1.2rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg, 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.22)); }
.lesson-password-dialog__header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem; }
.lesson-password-dialog__eyebrow { color: var(--color-warning, #b45309); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; }
.lesson-password-dialog__header h2 { margin: .2rem 0 0; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.lesson-password-dialog__close { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.25rem; }
.lesson-password-dialog__message, .lesson-password-dialog__error { margin: 0; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: .86rem; }
.lesson-password-dialog__error { color: var(--color-error, #dc2626); }
.lesson-password-dialog__label { font-weight: 700; font-size: .84rem; }
.lesson-password-dialog__field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: .45rem; }
.lesson-password-dialog__field input { min-height: 42px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: .55rem .65rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; }
.lesson-password-dialog__toggle { min-width: 52px; min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.lesson-password-dialog__actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: .2rem; }

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .lesson-ref-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .lesson-ref-card__actions { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); width: 100%; }
  .lesson-ref-card__action { min-width: 0; }
}
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .lesson-ref-card__main { gap: .55rem; }
  .lesson-ref-card { padding: .8rem; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .lesson-ref-card, .lesson-password-dialog__panel { scroll-behavior: auto; }
}
```

```javascript
// public/src/shared/flow-field.js
// Lightweight canvas flow-field background animation.

(function (global) {
  "use strict";

  const PARTICLE_COUNTS = {
    sparse: 600,
    medium: 1200,
    dense: 2000,
  };

  const THEMES = {
    dark: { hueStart: 220, hueRange: 120, saturation: 90, lightness: 62, bg: "18, 18, 18", trailAlpha: 0.06 },
    "dark-slate": { hueStart: 220, hueRange: 120, saturation: 90, lightness: 62, bg: "15, 23, 42", trailAlpha: 0.06 },
    light: { hueStart: 190, hueRange: 150, saturation: 82, lightness: 58, bg: "250, 251, 252", trailAlpha: 0.08 },
  };

  function fieldAngle(x, y, time) {
    const scale = 0.0025;
    return (
      Math.sin(x * scale + time * 0.0007) * Math.PI +
      Math.cos(y * scale + time * 0.0005) * Math.PI +
      Math.sin((x + y) * scale * 0.6 + time * 0.0009) * Math.PI * 0.6 +
      Math.cos((x - y) * scale * 0.4 + time * 0.0006) * Math.PI * 0.4
    );
  }

  let stylesInjected = false;
  function injectStyles() {
    if (stylesInjected) return;
    stylesInjected = true;
    const style = document.createElement("style");
    style.textContent = `
      .flow-field-root { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; }
      .flow-field-canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      .flow-field-vignette, .flow-field-fade-top, .flow-field-fade-bottom { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; pointer-events: none; }
      .flow-field-vignette { inset: 0; }
      .flow-field-fade-top { top: 0; height: 10rem; }
      .flow-field-fade-bottom { top: auto; bottom: 0; height: 10rem; }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function mount(container, options = {}) {
    if (!container) throw new Error("FlowField.mount: container element is required");
    injectStyles();

    let theme =
      options.theme ||
      document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") ||
      "light";
    let density = options.density || (global.innerWidth <= 768 ? "sparse" : "medium");
    let config = THEMES[theme] || THEMES.light;
    let count = PARTICLE_COUNTS[density] || PARTICLE_COUNTS.medium;
    const root = document.createElement("div");
    root.className = "flow-field-root";
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.className = "flow-field-canvas";
    canvas.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    const vignette = document.createElement("div");
    vignette.className = "flow-field-vignette";
    const fadeTop = document.createElement("div");
    fadeTop.className = "flow-field-fade-top";
    const fadeBottom = document.createElement("div");
    fadeBottom.className = "flow-field-fade-bottom";
    root.append(canvas, vignette, fadeTop, fadeBottom);
    container.appendChild(root);

    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const dpr = Math.min(global.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.5);
    let width = 0;
    let height = 0;
    let time = 0;
    let frameId = 0;
    let particles = [];
    let pageVisible = document.visibilityState !== "hidden";

    function applyBackground() {
      root.style.background = `rgb(${config.bg})`;
      vignette.style.background = `radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 60% at 50% 50%, transparent 20%, rgba(${config.bg}, 0.92) 100%)`;
      fadeTop.style.background = `linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(${config.bg}), transparent)`;
      fadeBottom.style.background = `linear-gradient(to top, rgb(${config.bg}), transparent)`;
    }

    function spawnParticle() {
      const maxLife = 200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300);
      return { x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, speed: 1.1 + Math.random() * 1.8, hue: config.hueStart + Math.random() * config.hueRange, life: Math.floor(Math.random() * maxLife), maxLife };
    }

    function resize() {
      width = global.innerWidth;
      height = global.innerHeight;
      canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
      context.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      context.fillStyle = `rgb(${config.bg})`;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      particles = Array.from({ length: count }, spawnParticle);
    }

    function scheduleRender() {
      if (!pageVisible || frameId) return;
      frameId = global.requestAnimationFrame(render);
    }

    function render() {
      frameId = 0;
      if (!pageVisible) return;
      time += 1;
      context.fillStyle = `rgba(${config.bg}, ${config.trailAlpha})`;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      particles.forEach((particle) => {
        const angle = fieldAngle(particle.x, particle.y, time);
        particle.x += Math.cos(angle) * particle.speed;
        particle.y += Math.sin(angle) * particle.speed;
        particle.life += 1;
        if (particle.life > particle.maxLife) Object.assign(particle, spawnParticle());
        if (particle.x < 0) particle.x += width;
        if (particle.x > width) particle.x -= width;
        if (particle.y < 0) particle.y += height;
        if (particle.y > height) particle.y -= height;
        const progress = particle.life / particle.maxLife;
        const alpha = Math.min(progress * 8, 1) * Math.min((1 - progress) * 6, 1) * 0.9;
        const hue = (particle.hue + (angle / (Math.PI * 2)) * 70 + 360) % 360;
        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(particle.x, particle.y, 1.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fillStyle = `hsla(${hue}, ${config.saturation}%, ${config.lightness}%, ${alpha})`;
        context.fill();
      });
      scheduleRender();
    }

    function onVisibilityChange() {
      pageVisible = document.visibilityState !== "hidden";
      if (pageVisible) {
        context.fillStyle = `rgb(${config.bg})`;
        context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        scheduleRender();
      }
    }

    applyBackground();
    resize();
    global.addEventListener("resize", resize);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibilityChange);
    scheduleRender();

    return {
      destroy() {
        global.cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
        global.removeEventListener("resize", resize);
        document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibilityChange);
        root.remove();
      },
      setTheme(nextTheme) { if (THEMES[nextTheme]) { theme = nextTheme; config = THEMES[theme]; applyBackground(); } },
      setDensity(nextDensity) { if (PARTICLE_COUNTS[nextDensity]) { density = nextDensity; count = PARTICLE_COUNTS[density]; particles = Array.from({ length: count }, spawnParticle); } },
    };
  }

  global.FlowField = { mount, THEMES, PARTICLE_COUNTS };
})(typeof window !== "undefined" ? window : this);

let flowFieldInstance = null;
let reducedMotionMedia = null;

function animationsAllowed() {
  const disabledBySetting = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-animations") === "disabled";
  if (disabledBySetting) return false;
  reducedMotionMedia ||= typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
    ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
    : null;
  return !reducedMotionMedia?.matches;
}

function initFlowField() {
  const enabled = animationsAllowed();
  if (enabled && !flowFieldInstance) {
    document.getElementById("flow-field-bg")?.remove();
    const container = document.createElement("div");
    container.id = "flow-field-bg";
    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
    const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || "light";
    flowFieldInstance = FlowField.mount(container, { theme: currentTheme });
  } else if (!enabled && flowFieldInstance) {
    flowFieldInstance.destroy();
    document.getElementById("flow-field-bg")?.remove();
    flowFieldInstance = null;
  }
}

function reactToAnimationsChange() {
  if (flowFieldInstance) {
    const theme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || "light";
    flowFieldInstance.setTheme(theme);
  }
  initFlowField();
}

function bootFlowField() {
  reducedMotionMedia ||= typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
    ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
    : null;
  initFlowField();
  document.addEventListener("quiz:animations-changed", reactToAnimationsChange);
  reducedMotionMedia?.addEventListener?.("change", reactToAnimationsChange);
  new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
    if (mutations.some((mutation) => mutation.attributeName === "data-animations" || mutation.attributeName === "data-theme")) {
      reactToAnimationsChange();
    }
  }).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-animations", "data-theme"] });
}

if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", bootFlowField);
else bootFlowField();

export { initFlowField };
```

## `public/src/shared/global-markdown-toolbar.js`
```javascript
// ============================================================================
// SHARED GLOBAL MARKDOWN + LATEX TOOLBAR
// ============================================================================
// Shared by create-lesson and create-quiz. The page supplies formatting and
// media callbacks; this module owns focus/selection safety, dropdown state,
// viewport placement, outside-click/Escape handling, and keyboard access.
// ============================================================================

import { mountColorPicker } from "./color-picker.js";

let activeTextarea = null;
const initializedBars = new WeakSet();
const barStates = new WeakMap();
let tipEl = null;
let tipTimer = null;

function escapeCss(value) {
  if (globalThis.CSS?.escape) return CSS.escape(String(value));
  return String(value).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, (ch) => `\\${ch}`);
}

function showNoFieldTip() {
  if (!tipEl) {
    tipEl = document.createElement("div");
    tipEl.className = "gmd-no-field-tip";
    tipEl.textContent = "انقر على حقل نصي أولاً";
    tipEl.setAttribute("role", "status");
    tipEl.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
    document.body.appendChild(tipEl);
  }
  clearTimeout(tipTimer);
  tipEl.classList.add("visible");
  tipTimer = window.setTimeout(() => tipEl?.classList.remove("visible"), 1800);
}

function trackTextareaFocus() {
  if (trackTextareaFocus.installed) return;
  trackTextareaFocus.installed = true;
  document.addEventListener("focusin", (event) => {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement && target.classList.contains("md-source")) {
      activeTextarea = target;
    }
  }, true);
}

function allMenus() {
  return [...document.querySelectorAll(".gmd-dropdown-menu")];
}

function findToggle(menu) {
  const id = menu?.id;
  if (!id) return null;
  return document.querySelector(`[data-gmd-menu-id="${escapeCss(id)}"]`);
}

export function closeAllGmdDropdowns() {
  for (const menu of allMenus()) {
    menu.classList.remove("open");
    menu.removeAttribute("data-gmd-open");
    menu.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    const toggle = findToggle(menu);
    toggle?.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
  }
}

function captureSelection() {
  const textarea = activeTextarea;
  if (!(textarea instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) || !document.body.contains(textarea)) return null;
  return {
    textarea,
    start: textarea.selectionStart ?? 0,
    end: textarea.selectionEnd ?? 0,
  };
}

function restoreSelection(selection) {
  const textarea = selection?.textarea;
  if (!(textarea instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) || !document.body.contains(textarea)) return null;
  activeTextarea = textarea;
  textarea.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  textarea.setSelectionRange(selection.start, selection.end);
  return textarea;
}

function directItems(menu) {
  return [...menu.querySelectorAll(":scope > button.gmd-btn:not([disabled])")];
}

function setRoving(menu, index) {
  const items = directItems(menu);
  if (!items.length) return;
  const safe = (index + items.length) % items.length;
  items.forEach((item, i) => item.setAttribute("tabindex", i === safe ? "0" : "-1"));
  items[safe].focus({ preventScroll: true });
}

function setupMenuKeyboard(menu, toggle) {
  if (menu.dataset.gmdKeyboardReady === "1") return;
  menu.dataset.gmdKeyboardReady = "1";
  menu.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
    const items = directItems(menu);
    const current = items.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      closeAllGmdDropdowns();
      toggle.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      return;
    }
    if (event.key === "Tab") {
      closeAllGmdDropdowns();
      return;
    }
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowRight") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setRoving(menu, current < 0 ? 0 : current + 1);
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowUp" || event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setRoving(menu, current < 0 ? items.length - 1 : current - 1);
    } else if (event.key === "Home") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setRoving(menu, 0);
    } else if (event.key === "End") {
      event.preventDefault();
      setRoving(menu, items.length - 1);
    }
  });
}

function positionMenu(toggle, menu) {
  const rect = toggle.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pad = 8;
  menu.style.visibility = "hidden";
  menu.style.position = "fixed";
  menu.style.display = "flex";
  menu.style.left = "0px";
  menu.style.top = "0px";
  menu.style.maxHeight = `${Math.max(140, window.innerHeight - pad * 2)}px`;

  const measuredWidth = menu.scrollWidth || menu.offsetWidth || 240;
  const width = Math.min(measuredWidth, Math.max(160, window.innerWidth - pad * 2));
  const measuredHeight = Math.min(menu.scrollHeight || menu.offsetHeight || 260, window.innerHeight - pad * 2);
  let left = rect.right - width;
  left = Math.max(pad, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - width - pad));

  const below = rect.bottom + 4;
  const above = rect.top - measuredHeight - 4;
  const top = below + measuredHeight <= window.innerHeight - pad
    ? below
    : (above >= pad ? above : window.innerHeight - measuredHeight - pad);

  menu.style.width = `${width}px`;
  menu.style.top = `${Math.max(pad, top)}px`;
  menu.style.left = `${left}px`;
  menu.style.visibility = "";
}

function detachMenus(bar, toggles) {
  for (const { toggle, menu } of toggles) {
    if (!menu?.id) continue;
    if (menu.parentElement !== document.body) document.body.appendChild(menu);
    menu.dataset.gmdDetached = "true";
    toggle.dataset.gmdMenuId = menu.id;
    menu.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  }
}

function setupHighlightPicker(menu, state, onAction) {
  if (!menu || state.picker) return;
  state.picker = mountColorPicker(
    menu,
    (hex) => {
      const restored = restoreSelection(state.highlightSelection);
      if (!restored) {
        showNoFieldTip();
        return;
      }
      onAction?.({
        cmd: "highlight",
        latex: null,
        extra: hex,
        textarea: restored,
        selection: { start: state.highlightSelection.start, end: state.highlightSelection.end },
      });
      closeAllGmdDropdowns();
    },
    closeAllGmdDropdowns,
    () => {
      closeAllGmdDropdowns();
      document.getElementById("gmdHighlightToggle")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    },
  );
}

/**
 * @param {{barId?:string,onAction?:(payload:object)=>void,onMedia?:(type:string,textarea:HTMLTextAreaElement|null)=>void}} options
 */
export function setupGlobalMarkdownToolbar({ barId = "globalMdBar", onAction, onMedia } = {}) {
  const bar = document.getElementById(barId);
  if (!bar) return null;
  if (initializedBars.has(bar)) return barStates.get(bar)?.api || null;
  initializedBars.add(bar);
  trackTextareaFocus();

  const state = { picker: null, highlightSelection: null, activeSelection: null, toggles: [] };
  barStates.set(bar, state);

  // Capture the menu relationship BEFORE detaching the popover into body.
  bar.querySelectorAll(".gmd-dropdown-toggle").forEach((toggle, index) => {
    const menu = toggle.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains("gmd-dropdown-menu")
      ? toggle.nextElementSibling
      : null;
    if (!menu) return;
    if (!menu.id) menu.id = `${bar.id}-dropdown-${index + 1}`;
    toggle.dataset.gmdMenuId = menu.id;
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "menu");
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-controls", menu.id);
    menu.setAttribute("role", "menu");
    menu.querySelectorAll(".gmd-btn").forEach((item) => {
      item.setAttribute("role", "menuitem");
      item.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
      item.setAttribute("type", "button");
    });
    state.toggles.push({ toggle, menu });
  });
  detachMenus(bar, state.toggles);

  // Menus are detached into <body>, so bind action buttons from both the
  // toolbar and the detached popovers. Binding after detachment also prevents
  // selector changes in either page from silently losing menu behavior.
  const actionButtons = [
    ...bar.querySelectorAll(".gmd-btn:not(.gmd-dropdown-toggle)"),
    ...state.toggles.flatMap(({ menu }) => [...menu.querySelectorAll(".gmd-btn:not(.gmd-dropdown-toggle)")]),
  ];
  actionButtons.forEach((button) => {
    button.setAttribute("type", "button");
    button.addEventListener("mousedown", (event) => event.preventDefault());
    button.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const stored = state.activeSelection;
      const textarea = restoreSelection(stored) || (activeTextarea && document.body.contains(activeTextarea) ? activeTextarea : null);
      const selection = stored && textarea === stored.textarea
        ? { start: stored.start, end: stored.end }
        : (textarea ? { start: textarea.selectionStart ?? 0, end: textarea.selectionEnd ?? 0 } : null);
      const cmd = button.dataset.gmdCmd || null;
      if (["image", "audio", "video"].includes(cmd)) {
        if (typeof onMedia === "function") onMedia(cmd, textarea);
      } else if (typeof onAction === "function") {
        if (!textarea) {
          showNoFieldTip();
        } else {
          onAction({
            cmd,
            latex: button.dataset.gmdLatex !== undefined ? button.dataset.gmdLatex : null,
            extra: button.dataset.gmdHeading || button.dataset.gmdColor || null,
            textarea,
            selection,
          });
        }
      }
      state.activeSelection = null;
      closeAllGmdDropdowns();
    });
  });

  const highlightMenu = document.getElementById("gmdHighlightMenu");
  if (highlightMenu) setupHighlightPicker(highlightMenu, state, onAction);

  for (const { toggle, menu } of state.toggles) {
    setupMenuKeyboard(menu, toggle);
    toggle.addEventListener("mousedown", (event) => event.preventDefault());
    toggle.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if ((event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") && !menu.classList.contains("open")) {
        event.preventDefault();
        toggle.click();
      } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
        closeAllGmdDropdowns();
      }
    });
    toggle.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const wasOpen = menu.classList.contains("open");
      if (wasOpen) {
        state.activeSelection = null;
        closeAllGmdDropdowns();
        return;
      }

      // Capture the editor range before focus can move into the detached
      // viewport popover. This range is restored when a dropdown item is
      // chosen, so formatting never jumps to the wrong cursor position.
      state.activeSelection = captureSelection();
      closeAllGmdDropdowns();
      if (menu.id === "gmdHighlightMenu") {
        state.highlightSelection = state.activeSelection;
        state.picker?.refresh();
      }
      positionMenu(toggle, menu);
      menu.classList.add("open");
      menu.setAttribute("data-gmd-open", "true");
      menu.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

      const items = directItems(menu);
      items.forEach((item, i) => item.setAttribute("tabindex", i === 0 ? "0" : "-1"));
      if (event.detail === 0) {
        if (menu.id === "gmdHighlightMenu") state.picker?.focusFirst();
        else items[0]?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    });
  }

  const reposition = () => {
    const open = document.querySelector(".gmd-dropdown-menu.open[data-gmd-open]");
    if (!open) return;
    const toggle = findToggle(open);
    if (toggle) positionMenu(toggle, open);
  };
  window.addEventListener("resize", reposition, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("scroll", reposition, { passive: true, capture: true });

  // A single document-level Escape handler makes keyboard dismissal reliable
  // even when focus is inside a detached menu item or the color picker.
  if (!setupGlobalMarkdownToolbar.escapeInstalled) {
    setupGlobalMarkdownToolbar.escapeInstalled = true;
    document.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
      const open = document.querySelector(".gmd-dropdown-menu.open[data-gmd-open]");
      if (!open) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const toggle = findToggle(open);
      closeAllGmdDropdowns();
      toggle?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }, true);
  }

  // Close only when the pointer starts outside the bar and all detached menus.
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
    const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : null;
    if (!target) return;
    if (target.closest(`#${escapeCss(bar.id)}`) || target.closest(".gmd-dropdown-menu")) return;
    state.activeSelection = null;
    closeAllGmdDropdowns();
  });

  state.api = {
    getActiveTextarea: () => activeTextarea && document.body.contains(activeTextarea) ? activeTextarea : null,
    captureSelection,
    restoreSelection,
    closeAll: closeAllGmdDropdowns,
  };
  return state.api;
}

export { activeTextarea };
```

## `public/src/shared/markdown-toolbar-actions.js`
```javascript
// ============================================================================
// SHARED MARKDOWN / LATEX TOOLBAR ACTIONS
// ============================================================================
// Pure editor-side formatting used by both create-lesson and create-quiz.
// The global toolbar owns focus, dropdown state and selection capture; this
// module owns the actual text transformation so the two editors cannot drift.
// ============================================================================

function replaceTextareaRange(textarea, start, end, text) {
  textarea.focus();
  textarea.setSelectionRange(start, end);
  const nativeInsert = typeof document.execCommand === "function"
    ? document.execCommand("insertText", false, text)
    : false;
  if (!nativeInsert) {
    const value = textarea.value;
    textarea.value = value.slice(0, start) + text + value.slice(end);
    const cursor = start + text.length;
    textarea.setSelectionRange(cursor, cursor);
  }
}

function resizeTextarea(textarea) {
  textarea.style.height = "auto";
  const maxPx = textarea.id?.startsWith("option-text-") ? 140 : 240;
  const minPx = textarea.id?.startsWith("option-text-") ? 36 : 40;
  const next = Math.min(Math.max(textarea.scrollHeight || minPx, minPx), maxPx);
  textarea.style.height = `${next}px`;
  textarea.style.overflowY = (textarea.scrollHeight || minPx) > maxPx ? "auto" : "hidden";
}

/**
 * Applies one toolbar command to a previously captured textarea selection.
 *
 * @param {{cmd?: string|null, latex?: string|null, extra?: string|number|null, textarea?: HTMLTextAreaElement|null}} payload
 * @returns {boolean} whether an editor mutation was applied
 */
export function applyMarkdownToolbarAction({ cmd = null, latex = null, extra = null, textarea = null } = {}) {
  if (!(textarea instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) || !document.body.contains(textarea)) return false;

  const start = textarea.selectionStart ?? 0;
  const end = textarea.selectionEnd ?? start;
  const value = textarea.value || "";
  const selected = value.slice(start, end);

  const wrap = (prefix, suffix = prefix, placeholder = "") => {
    const text = selected || placeholder;
    replaceTextareaRange(textarea, start, end, prefix + text + suffix);
    const contentStart = start + prefix.length;
    textarea.setSelectionRange(contentStart, contentStart + text.length);
  };

  const linePrefix = (prefix) => {
    const lineStart = value.lastIndexOf("\n", start - 1) + 1;
    const lineEnd = end > start ? end : lineStart;
    const affected = value.slice(lineStart, lineEnd);
    const newLines = (affected || "")
      .split("\n")
      .map((line) => (line.startsWith(prefix) ? line : prefix + line))
      .join("\n");
    replaceTextareaRange(textarea, lineStart, lineEnd, newLines);
    textarea.setSelectionRange(lineStart, lineStart + newLines.length);
  };

  if (latex !== null && latex !== undefined) {
    const snippet = selected ? selected + String(latex) : String(latex);
    const inserted = `$${snippet}$`;
    replaceTextareaRange(textarea, start, end, inserted);
    const braceIndex = inserted.indexOf("{}");
    const cursor = braceIndex !== -1
      ? start + braceIndex + 1
      : start + Math.max(0, inserted.length - 1);
    textarea.setSelectionRange(cursor, cursor);
  } else {
    switch (cmd) {
      case "bold":
        wrap("**", "**", "نص غامق");
        break;
      case "italic":
        wrap("*", "*", "نص مائل");
        break;
      case "strike":
        wrap("~~", "~~", "نص مشطوب");
        break;
      case "code":
        wrap("`", "`", "كود");
        break;
      case "codeblock": {
        const text = selected || "كود";
        const inserted = `\`\`\`\n${text}\n\`\`\``;
        replaceTextareaRange(textarea, start, end, inserted);
        const contentStart = start + 4;
        textarea.setSelectionRange(contentStart, contentStart + text.length);
        break;
      }
      case "heading": {
        const level = Math.min(Math.max(Number(extra) || 3, 1), 6);
        linePrefix("#".repeat(level) + " ");
        break;
      }
      case "blockquote":
        linePrefix("> ");
        break;
      case "hr": {
        const inserted = "\n---\n";
        replaceTextareaRange(textarea, start, end, inserted);
        const cursor = start + inserted.length;
        textarea.setSelectionRange(cursor, cursor);
        break;
      }
      case "ul":
        linePrefix("- ");
        break;
      case "ol":
        linePrefix("1. ");
        break;
      case "link": {
        const text = selected || "نص الرابط";
        replaceTextareaRange(textarea, start, end, `[${text}](https://)`);
        const urlStart = start + text.length + 3;
        textarea.setSelectionRange(urlStart, urlStart + "https://".length);
        break;
      }
      case "table": {
        const table = "| العمود 1 | العمود 2 |\n| --- | --- |\n| قيمة | قيمة |";
        const needsLeadingNewline = start > 0 && value[start - 1] !== "\n";
        const inserted = (needsLeadingNewline ? "\n" : "") + table;
        replaceTextareaRange(textarea, start, end, inserted);
        const cursor = start + inserted.length;
        textarea.setSelectionRange(cursor, cursor);
        break;
      }
      case "inlinemath":
        wrap("$", "$", "math");
        break;
      case "blockmath":
        wrap("$$", "$$", "math");
        break;
      case "highlight": {
        const text = selected || "نص مظلل";
        const color = typeof extra === "string" ? extra : "";
        const suffix = color ? `(${color})` : "";
        replaceTextareaRange(textarea, start, end, `==${text}==${suffix}`);
        const contentStart = start + 2;
        textarea.setSelectionRange(contentStart, contentStart + text.length);
        break;
      }
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  resizeTextarea(textarea);
  textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  textarea.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  return true;
}

export { replaceTextareaRange };
```
